title: 任务界面与用户审查
scope: 有限候选/实例/规则及历史审阅，按v1/v2显示作用域与来源；本机app接外加澄清、修订产物登记、显式采纳和独立资格检查。无自动模型调用或完整Studio。

dependency_semantics.implementation: Design-only public CommandBinding consumption; finite candidate review does not import or execute an implementation backend.

implemented_scope: Standard-library exact finite-domain/0.1 and /0.2 presentation: expressions, invariant versus eligibility scope, original-source/action evidence, external question/correction/answer and separately attributed interpretation. The app consumes shared clarification, method-pinned revision registration, deliberate adoption/history and saved-instance eligibility APIs. Unknown/error remain visible, qualification never implies action execution, and v0.2 application configuration is explicitly unsupported. Legacy offline ordinary-answer export and v0.1 specification preview/confirmation/save remain. No state ownership, evaluator duplication, model transport or authentication service.
